summary: Transfer a specific piece of information, such as an identifier, email, name, or amount, from a source website to a destination website by copying it before switching tabs.
preconditions: The source website containing the required information is open and active.
The destination website is open in a background tab.
steps: Locate the target value (e.g., name, email, ID, or amount) on the current page.
Select the target value using the mouse cursor.
Copy the selected value to the clipboard using a keyboard shortcut or right-click menu.
Switch to the browser tab containing the destination website.

variants.when: The text cannot be selected or copied directly from the page
variants.do: Carefully read and memorize the value, or manually type it into a temporary text area before switching tabs.

watch_for: The target text is highlighted correctly without extra leading or trailing spaces.
The destination tab successfully loads and becomes the active window.
completion_signal: The destination tab is active and the cursor is ready to paste or input the carried value.
pitfalls: Copying surrounding whitespace or labels instead of just the raw value.
Accidentally overwriting the clipboard before pasting the value into the destination site.
Switching to the wrong tab or window.
